items.title: What's different about Microsoft's Copilot AI reboot
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) launched a reboot of Copilot, shifting its focus from personal AI to workplace use. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what you should know.

items.title: CEO Satya Nadella on Microsoft's AI bet
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa sat down with Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella to discuss its cloud-based Autopilot update, consumer trust in AI agents, and how US and China might find common ground on AI development and safety as Chinese President Xi Jinping visits Washington to meet with President Trump.

items.title: Microsoft CEO: Autopilot is the 'next generation' of enterprise AI
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa sat down with Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella to discuss how its cloud-based Autopilot update fits into the tech giant's ecosystem of AI agents and products.

items.title: Goldman Sachs just gave AI stock fans a cold, hard reality check
items.summary: Goldman Sachs strategist Ryan Hammond thinks hyperscalers like Amazon, Oracle, and Microsoft need to generate about $300 billion in AI revenue in the "next few years" to break even on their investments.
